Method of Attack: Remote Code Execution (RCE) via data binding and parameter binding to access ClassLoader variables
Impacted Systems: Spring Framework applications running on JDK 9+ and Apache Tomcat as the Servlet container, packaged as WAR
Attack Vector: POST parameters through class.module.classLoader to write malicious JSP files
Indicators of Compromise: CachedIntrospectionResults.java file, methods CachedIntrospectionResults and introspectInterfaces

Method of Attack: Remote Code Execution (RCE) via specially crafted SpEL as a routing-expression
Impacted Systems: Spring Cloud Function applications using routing functionality
Attack Vector: SpEL expression provided via Message Headers evaluated in the scope of StandardEvaluationContext
Indicators of Compromise: RoutingFunction.java file, methods route and functionFromExpression

Method of Attack: Denial of Service (DoS) via specially crafted SpEL expression to create a large array causing OutOfMemoryError
Attack Vector: SpEL expression attempting to create a large array
